_comment: Frozen sample set for the tiny-overfit correctness gate.
A gate whose input changes between runs is not a gate, so these IDs are committed
rather than sampled. Only identifiers are stored here: CVL is CC BY-NC 4.0 and its
transcripts are not redistributed by this repository.
glyphmemory data prepare --dataset cvl --source datasets/CVL --out runs/cvl

criterion.note: Near-memorization, not exact. CTC on real ink at 4x downsampling need not reach exactly zero, and demanding 0% would invite tuning to satisfy the gate. This is a correctness result about the pipeline, never a performance claim about handwriting.

selection.rule: encodable under charset_en_v1, stratified across the full width range
selection.ordering: bit-reversal over the width-sorted list, so any prefix taken by --limit spans the full width range rather than the narrowest lines
